## Caterpillar Inc. (CAT) — Counterparty Credit Brief

**1. Company overview** — Caterpillar Inc., large-cap manufacturer of construction, mining, and energy/transportation equipment (NYSE: CAT, CIK 0000018230).

**2. Public financial position** (10-K, equity including noncontrolling interests, per TRS-POL-011):

| FY | LT debt (noncurrent) | Equity (incl. NCI) | Form / filed |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2022 | $25,714M | $15,891M | 10-K filed 2024-02-16 |
| 2023 | $24,472M | $19,503M | 10-K filed 2025-02-14 |
| 2024 | $27,351M | $19,494M | 10-K filed 2026-02-13 |

**3. Leverage & trend** (LT debt / equity, average of yearly ratios):

| FY | LT D/E |
|---|---|
| 2022 | 1.6181 |
| 2023 | 1.2548 |
| 2024 | 1.4030 |
| **3-yr avg** | **1.4253** |

Debt/equity fell sharply from 2022→2023 (equity jumped ~23% on a modest debt paydown), then ticked back up in 2024 as debt grew ~12% against roughly flat equity.

**4. Leverage classification** — per policy, classification uses the latest completed fiscal year alone (FY2024 = 1.4030), which falls in the **moderate** band (1.0–3.0 inclusive) → standard terms, annual review. The 3-yr average (1.4253) is context only, not the classifier input.

**5. Internal relationship** — checked both the ERP **Customers** and **Vendors** masters (no match) and Books/QBO customer records (no match): **none**. Caterpillar is not currently a customer or vendor of ours — this would be a new counterparty relationship.

**6. Risk flags & recommendation (analyst judgment)** — Leverage is comfortably within the moderate band and trending better than the 2022 peak, though FY2024's uptick is worth flagging as a trend to watch next cycle. No existing exposure to layer risk onto. Recommend standard terms with annual review, consistent with policy treatment for the moderate band; no enhanced security required at this time.
